title: Discernment and the Spirit
definition: Discernment and the Spirit refers to the Spirit's work in helping believers test teachings, spirits, desires, and decisions by the truth of God.
summary: The Spirit gives discernment that agrees with Scripture and glorifies Christ.
christFocus: Jesus gives the Spirit of Truth so His people may recognize truth and reject deception.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discernment is not suspicion, pride, or spiritual elitism. It is the Spirit-enabled ability to distinguish truth from error and wisdom from folly.

The Spirit gives discernment through Scripture, the Gospel, prayer, maturity, and wise counsel. He does not lead people to reject the Word He inspired.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Spiritual language can be used to hide error. This doctrine matters because believers need the Spirit's help to test what claims to be from God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Spirit for discernment. Test teachings and impressions by Scripture, Christ's glory, Gospel truth, and the fruit they produce.

relatedTopics: Guidance and Conviction of the Holy Spirit
